entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE
entities.description: The EPS bearer context is active in the UE. This is one of the ESM sublayer states for EPS bearer context handling.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: The EPS bearer context is inactive in the UE. This is one of the ESM sublayer states for EPS bearer context handling.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: ESM message that transitions bearer context from INACTIVE to ACTIVE state.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: ESM message that transitions bearer context from INACTIVE to ACTIVE state.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: ESM message that transitions bearer context from ACTIVE to INACTIVE state.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT including cause value ≠ 49
entities.description: ESM message with specific cause value that transitions bearer context from ACTIVE to INACTIVE state.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT including cause value = 43
entities.description: ESM message with specific cause value that transitions bearer context from ACTIVE to INACTIVE state.
